question: The primary excretory product of _______ is uric acid.
solution:
The correct answer is __**birds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Ammonia, urea, uric acid, carbon dioxide, water, **and **ions** are all accumulated by animals either by **metabolic processes **or through other methods, such as **excessive intake.**
 
• **Ammonotelism** is the process of **excreting ammonia**.
 
• The **liver **of the **animal converts ammonia **produced by metabolism into **urea**, which is then released into the blood and filtered and eliminated by the kidneys.
 
• To maintain the desired **osmolarity**, some of these animals may retain a little quantity of urea in their **kidney matrix**.
 
• Animals that excrete nitrogenous wastes as **uric acid **in the form of **pellets **or paste while losing the least amount of water are referred to as **uricotelic**.
 
• These include **reptiles, birds, land snails, **and **insects. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Uric acid** is a typical **bodily **waste substance.
 
• It grows as **purine**-**containing compounds **break down.
 
• Purines are a substance that the **human body naturally **contains.
 
• A number of foods, such as** liver, seafood, **and **alcohol, **also contain them.
 
• They may potentially arise within the body when **DNA **is damaged.
